crossRefs.note: It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be…
It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

parallels.note: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

translations.web: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
translations.bsb: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
translations.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
translations.asv: for, Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
